items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the essay 'Follow That Dream', and answer.

"At twelve, Arjun wanted to be an astronaut. At fifteen, his eyesight test ended that dream. For a week he would not speak to anyone. Then his science teacher handed him a book about the engineers who design rockets. 'Someone has to build the ship,' she said. Today Arjun works on satellite engines, and he still keeps that book on his desk."

Answer the following:
(i) What was Arjun's first dream?  (a) To be a pilot  (b) To be an astronaut  (c) To be a teacher  (d) To be a doctor
(ii) What ended that dream?
(iii) How did his science teacher help him?
(iv) Which idea from "Follow That Dream" does Arjun's story show?  (a) Luck alone brings success  (b) Giving up dreams  (c) Dreams are useless  (d) Adapting a dream with support when hurdles arise
items.answer: (i) (b) To be an astronaut (ii) His eyesight test at fifteen. (iii) She gave him a book about rocket engineers and suggested he could build the ship instead. (iv) (d) Adapting a dream with support when hurdles arise
items.markingKey: (i) (b) To be an astronaut (ii) His eyesight test at fifteen. (iii) She gave him a book about rocket engineers and suggested he could build the ship instead. (iv) (d) Adapting a dream with support when hurdles arise (1 mark each, 4 marks.)
